## Quarto

#2 AGE MONTHS AND EDUCATION ON HOUSEHOLD INCOME (CONTINUOUS) HEATMAP 

shiny ideas: hover on tiles to show proportion of people in each category
```{r}

df <- NHANES |> 
  filter(!is.na(AgeMonths), !is.na(Education), !is.na(HHIncomeMid), !is.na(Gender))

#Heatmap of AgeMonths (Categorical), Education (Categorical), HHIncome (Continuous)
ggplot(df, aes(x = AgeMonths, y = Education, fill = HHIncomeMid)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(title = "Age Months and Education Level on Household Income",
       x = "Age Months", 
       y = "Education Level", 
       fill = "Household Income") +
  #coord_fixed() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +
  theme_minimal()

#Heatmap of AgeMonths (Categorical), Education (Categorical), HHIncome (Continuous) stratified by Gender
ggplot(df, aes(x = AgeMonths, y = Education, fill = HHIncomeMid)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~ Gender) +
  labs(title = "Age Months and Education Level on Household Income, Stratified by Gender",
       x = "Age Months", 
       y = "Education Level", 
       fill = "Household Income") +
  #coord_fixed() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +
  theme_minimal()
```
# [DO NOT USE] 1 - PHYSICAL ACTIVITY BINARY AND BMI CONTINUOUS

```{r}
df <- NHANES |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(PhysActive), !is.na(BMI))

#Boxplots yes/no - BMI continuous
ggplot(df, aes(x = PhysActive, y = BMI, fill = PhysActive)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "BMI by Physical Activity Status")

#Facets by gender - BMI continuous
ggplot(df, aes(x = PhysActive, y = BMI, fill = PhysActive)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ Gender) +
  labs(title = "BMI by Physical Activity, Stratified by Gender")
```



## [DO NOT USE] 2 - PHYSICAL ACTIVITY BINARY AND BMI CATEGORICAL

```{r}
df <- NHANES |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(PhysActive), !is.na(BMI_WHO))

#Bar plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = BMI_WHO, fill = PhysActive)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "BMI Category Distribution by Physical Activity",
       x = "BMI Category", y = "Count")

#Stacked bar plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = BMI_WHO, fill = PhysActive)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(title = "Proportion of BMI Categories by Physical Activity",
       x = "BMI Category", y = "Proportion")

#Bar plot by gender
ggplot(df, aes(x = BMI_WHO, fill = PhysActive)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ Gender) +
  labs(title = "BMI Category by Physical Activity, Stratified by Gender")

#Stacked bar plot by gender
ggplot(df, aes(x = BMI_WHO, fill = PhysActive)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  facet_wrap(~ Gender) +
  labs(title = "Proportion of BMI Categories by Physical Activity",
       x = "BMI Category", y = "Proportion")
```

# # [DO NOT USE] 3 - PHYSICAL ACTIVITY DAYS AND BMI

```{r}
df <- NHANES |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(PhysActiveDays), !is.na(BMI))

#Boxplots
df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(PhysActiveDays), y = BMI, fill = factor(PhysActiveDays))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "BMI by Number of Physically Active Days per Week",
    x = "Physically Active Days (0–7)",
    y = "BMI"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(fill = "none")

#Boxplots by gender
df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(PhysActiveDays), 
             y = BMI, 
             fill = factor(PhysActiveDays))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ Gender) +
  labs(
    title = "BMI by Physical Activity Days per Week, Stratified by Gender",
    x = "Physical Activity Days (0–7)",
    y = "BMI"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(fill = "none")
```

# # [DO NOT USE]4 - PHYSICAL ACTIVITY DAYS AND BMI CATEGORICAL

```{r}
df <- NHANES |>
